A straightforward one-step disconnection is a Baeyer‑Villiger oxidation of the corresponding bicyclic ketone to give the ester. The required precursors are the ketone (the bicyclic ketone) and a peracid such as m‑chloroperbenzoic acid (mCPBA). Both the ketone and mCPBA are commercially available and inexpensive, satisfying the price limit. First, verify that the ketone is buyable.</thought>
